terms: TERMS: Progressive jackpot = prize that grows with every bet placed. RTP = percent returned to players over time. Hold & Spin = special symbols lock while respins continue. Megaways = Big Time Gaming mechanic with changing reels, up to 117,649 ways. Slingo = slots plus bingo. LuckyTap = instant-win game format. Bonus Buy = pay to trigger the feature. Wild substitutes; Scatter triggers free spins.
tables: TABLE GAMES: Blackjack natural pays 3 to 2; blackjack is the most popular casino card game in North America. Roulette American wheel has 38 pockets (0 and 00); straight 35:1, split 17:1, street 11:1, corner 8:1, six-line 5:1. Baccarat banker bet pays 1:1 minus 5% commission, tie pays 8:1. Craps pass line wins on 7/11 and loses on 2/3/12. Poker ranks high to low: royal flush, straight flush, four of a kind, full house, flush, straight, three of a kind, two pair, pair, high card.
